tools.description: Searches Python source files under /testbed for a literal or regular expression and returns matching file paths, line numbers, and surrounding snippets. Useful for locating definitions, call sites, and related code without shell or git access.
tools.label: Read-only source code occurrence search
tools.name: code_occurrence_search

context_lines.description: Number of lines of context to include around each match, default 2.

max_matches.description: Maximum number of matches to return, default 50.

pattern.description: Literal text or regular expression to find.

regex.description: Treat pattern as a regular expression, default true.
